data.name: Ajnabee - The Unknown
data.detailed_description:
Please Note: This is not a jump scare–heavy horror game. Fear is built through atmosphere, story, and unsettling situations. The game is heavily narrative-driven, with cinematics playing an important role in the overall experience.

What would you do… if someone entered your home,

changed things quietly, and left before you could ever see them?

AJNABEE THE UNKNOWN

Ajnabee – The Unknown is a cinematic story-driven psychological horror game which focuses on atmosphere, tension, and immersive storytelling. You play as Naina, a young woman living a quiet, everyday life that slowly begins to fall apart when something unseen starts interfering with her reality.

Through exploration, interaction, and observation, the game places you directly inside moments of fear where even the smallest disturbance feels threatening.

A Psychological Horror Experience You Live Through

Imagine this.

You’re inside your home, going about your usual routine. Everything feels normal.

Until it doesn’t.

You Hear Something

A sound breaks the silence.
It feels close.

You pause.
You look around.
You search the house.

Nothing.

Yet the feeling remains—as if someone was just there.

You Try to Protect Yourself

Fear begins to settle in.

You start closing windows.
Locking doors.
Making sure everything is secured.

The house feels quieter now.
But not safer.

You Wake Up Again

While sleeping, you hear it again.

The same sound.
The same presence.

Your eyes open slowly.
Your heart starts racing.

Something Has Changed

You get up to check.

A window is open.

You remember closing it.
You’re certain of it.

The silence feels heavier than before.

A Message Is Left Behind

You find a note.

Someone has been inside your home.
Not to take anything—but to leave a message.

A message meant only for you.

From this moment on, the fear is no longer subtle.

A Short Story Overview

Naina lives alone while her fiancé, Vivek, is away on a work trip. Her days begin normally, following the same quiet routine until she starts hearing someone humming inside her home. Every time she checks, no one is there. Yet the feeling of someone’s presence never leaves.

As days pass, the signs become impossible to ignore. Naina feels watched. Things change without explanation. Someone enters her space and leaves without being seen. Soon, she begins to find notes left behind by the same unknown person. Messages that speak of love she never asked for, and attention that feels deeply unsettling.

Terrified, Naina reaches out for help. She talks to Vivek. She goes to the police. She tries everything she can to feel safe again. But nothing stops it. The presence remains. The humming returns. The notes keep appearing.

Slowly, her home stops feeling like a place of comfort.
Everyday life turns into fear.
And the question remains, how close is the one who refuses to leave her alone?

Storytelling Through Atmosphere

The narrative of Ajnabee – The Unknown unfolds through:

  • Environmental changes

  • Notes and objects

  • Sound cues and silence

  • Cinematic sequences

The game never forces exposition. Instead, it allows players to experience the story naturally, piece by piece, as tension steadily builds.

Key Features

  • 🕯️ Psychological Horror Gameplay – Fear driven by atmosphere and tension

  • 🎬 Cinematic, Story-Driven Experience – Immersive narrative progression

  • 🏠 Interactive Environments – Everyday spaces that slowly feel unsafe

  • 🎧 Immersive Sound Design – Audio cues that shape fear and paranoia

  • 🧠 Emotionally Driven Horror – Focus on vulnerability and obsession

  • Psychological Horror Set in India – A grounded, familiar setting

Ajnabee – The Unknown invites you to experience fear through presence the feeling that someone knows you, watches you, and refuses to let go.

data.short_description: A cinematic, story-driven psychological horror game where you play as Naina, a young woman living alone in India, stalked by an unknown stalker while her fiancé is overseas. Fear comes from atmosphere, suspense, and storytelling rather than frequent jump scares.

content_descriptors.notes:
Ajnabee – The Unknown contains psychological horror, mature themes, and intense narrative situations that may be disturbing or uncomfortable for some players.

The game depicts stalking, obsessive behavior, intimidation, fear, emotional distress, and criminal acts. These themes are presented as negative and harmful behaviors and are not glorified.

The game includes tense and frightening sequences designed to create psychological unease. Some scenes also feature dizziness-inducing visual effects and claustrophobic environments, which may be uncomfortable for players who are sensitive to these effects. If you experience discomfort while playing, please stop playing and take a break.

The story contains non-graphic, realistic violence, including physical confrontations, threats involving weapons, and a climactic scene in which a character is shot. Violence is presented without graphic gore. There is no dismemberment or explicit depiction of blood.

The game also contains romance and emotionally intense relationship themes, but there is no sexual content or nudity.

The game does not contain:

• Sexual content or nudity
• Sexual assault
• Drug or alcohol abuse
• Self-harm or suicide
• Graphic gore or dismemberment

Ajnabee – The Unknown is intended for a mature audience primarily because of its psychological intensity, emotional themes, frightening situations, and depictions of violence, rather than explicit or graphic content.
